spec2def(usp10.dll usp10.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# usp10.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/usp10-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(usp10_shims OBJECT bidi.c bracket.c breaking.c direction.c indic.c indicsyllable.c linebreak.c mirror.c opentype.c shape.c shaping.c usp10.c)
target_link_libraries(usp10_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libadvapi32 libuser32 libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(usp10_shims)
add_cargo_module(usp10 usp10-cargo usp10.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS usp10_shims psdk)
